minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, October 19, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 19, 2022.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Scott Snider, Lorraine Missick, Bette
  Donovan, Jenny Jolly and Edward Padgett.

  Members absent: Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist.

  Guest present: Mayor Tim Hepburn.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, September
  21, 2022 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, meals were distributed to an
  average of 147 participants per week in September.

  Congregate meals: Meals were served to an average of 19 participants per weeks in
  September.

  Meals on Wheels: 749 meals were served to 43 La Verne recipients in September.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month was $3508.77. The
  flash board was repaired but an IT person is still needed. Daubers will be passed out
  for Christmas as Christmas gifts. On 10/28 for Halloween, a single pull tab will be
  given out to each player at no charge. Every winning player will receive an additional
  pull tab. Bingo is requesting entertainment for Halloween Bingo from the High
  School starting at 11:45 AM.

5. Account Balance: $6,211.86.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Registration was held for winter term.
 8. Aging Next: No report.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Getting estimates for the renovation of the kitchen at Veterans Hall.
  Getting estimates for replacing the carpet at the community center or replacing it
  with vinyl flooring.

10. Upcoming Events:
  - Tuesday, October 25th– Excursion: Oak Tree Mountain, 8:00 AM
  - Wednesday, October 26th– Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
  - Thursday, October 27th– Halloween Line Dancing Party, 10:00 AM
  - Wednesday, November 2nd– Excursion: San Diego Zoo, 9:00AM
  - Wednesday, November 2nd– Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
  - Friday, November 4th– Senior Seminar, 9:30 Am
  - Friday November 4th– Flu Shot/COVID-19 Vaccine and Mammogram
  Coach, 10:00 AM-1:00 PM
  - Sunday, November 6th– Senior Dinner Dance, 4:00 PM
  - Thursday, November 10th– Friday, November 11th: Center Closed,
  Veteran’s Day!
  - Monday, November 14th– Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  - Tuesday, November 15th– Excursion: Leonis Adobe Museum in
  Calabasas 8:00 AM

11. Public Comments: Senior Advisory Committee will not meet in December.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 10:56 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, November 16, 2022 at 10:00 AM.
